title.narrative: Water and environmental sanitation in the Republic of Mali

description.narrative: Digging 42 medium-depth artesian wells, building 15 toilet units, distributing 40 water tanks with a capacity of 2000 liters, maintaining a safe and sound environment, and sustaining the project activities through periodic maintenance while limiting the spread of epidemic diseases and spreading awareness among citizens about a clean, healthy environment for (a number of) 1,162,000) beneficiaries

Providing sources of potable water for needy areas in the Republic of Mali, improving hygiene habits in society and providing the means for this, through several activities, including digging 42 artesian wells of medium depth, building 15 toilet units, each unit consisting of 4 toilets, and distributing a number 40 water tank

Providing water suitable for drinking and human use, preserving its sources, and contributing to reducing diseases and deaths related to water and hygiene, in order to improve the lives of the poor in rural areas and resettle the indigenous people of the targeted areas who do not have access to safe drinking water.
